summary.zh: 在 DSH 进程内直接运行 magpie 的供应商插件：继承已装的插件与已登录账号，把每个供应商注册成一条模型路由。桌面用 magpie 原版界面（已跟到上游 v0.1.4916），手机是四个原生页签——平台列表默认摊开各账号并可逐个隐藏、用量统计、插件商店一键安装、账号备份可以在电脑和手机之间搬。输入框上方还有额度条与每回合消耗脚注。
summary.en: Runs magpie's vendor-plugin ecosystem inside DSH: inherits installed plugins and signed-in accounts, and registers every provider as a model route. Desktop uses the original magpie UI (synced to upstream v0.1.4916); mobile gets four native tabs with accounts laid out per provider and hideable one by one, usage stats, one-click store installs, and account backup that moves between desktop and phone. Also adds a quota strip above the composer and a per-turn usage footnote.
